Two things sit at the heart of it, networking and systems administration , and you move between them and everything around them rather than owning one narrow lane. You do not need to know all of it on day one; you need the foundation and the drive to grow into the rest, which is exactly how the person before you did it. Be the person colleagues can bring a problem to, wherever they sit, and sort out the office networks and hardware they depend on. → Troubleshoot to the root cause. When something breaks, find why, fix it, and write it down so it does not come back. Keeping things secure is part of the job throughout. → Make things easier with automation. Comfortable around Microsoft 365 or Windows Server, enough to build on. If you have touched PowerShell or a bit of cloud, even better. → A security-minded way of working. You keep things safe by habit. Depth here grows on the job. → Troubleshooting instinct: you isolate a problem methodically instead of guessing, and you document what you did. → Driven, curious, adaptable: you want to know how things work and go find out, and you stay steady when priorities and topics shift. If your foundation and drive fit, we will talk within a few days. The Customization Group Columbus Cologne Leipzig Berlin Munich Szczecin Riga Dubai Saigon thecustomizationgroup.com We welcome applications from all backgrounds. What matters is your foundation and your willingness to learn.
